They are not job-analysis results and no human has reviewed them. Credential gates and sign-off are shown only as drafts until an E-labelled source is attached.

- **Role:** Solid waste and materials management specialist (`seed:R29-solid-waste-materials-specialist`, P2); authority position (editorial): regulated-party
- **Generated:** pipelines/views/state_class_view.py@0.1.0, rule state-class-view@0.1.0 (proposed), as of 2026-10-23

## Mapped classes

No class is mapped in the pilot jurisdictions (TX, WA and PA (state), Lewis County WA (county environmental health), Philadelphia Water Department (municipal utility)). The role's targets below are what a jurisdiction would crosswalk its own class specification against.

## Competency targets by role level (agent draft)

- Operate solid waste collection, processing and disposal systems to permit conditions — journey L2, senior L3, lead L4
- Regulate solid waste and materials management facilities — journey L2, senior L3, lead L4
- Administer extended producer responsibility and materials-management programmes — journey L2, senior L3, lead L4
- Conduct regulatory compliance inspections — journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Develop materials-management strategies that keep products and materials in use — journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Plan and run waste reduction programmes for facilities and communities — journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
